title: Sweetwater Grade 1 lesson plan, week of Nov 16
scope: Excerpts only: lesson-content lines ClassThread items cite. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information.
content:
[11/16 | Foundations, Lesson Title] Beacon Reading and Math will be given this week
[11/16 | Foundations, Thursday (session 4), Learning Targets] Read and write words with dr and tr.
[11/16 | Foundations, Vocabulary & Strategy] Super Words: into, more, one, your; by, come, my, some
[11/16 | Writing, Monday, Learning Targets] Show who owns something.
[11/16 | Writing, Monday, Learning Targets] Use describing words to tell more about a noun.
[11/16 | Writing, Tuesday, Success Criteria] Use words like above, below, on, under to write my sentence about the ocean.
[11/16 | Writing, Wednesday, You Do] Have students look at the word shiver.
[11/16 | Math (Lesson 12), Tuesday Session 2, Learning Target] Today I will use a bar model and an equation to find how many more or how many fewer.
[11/16 | Math (Lesson 12), Wednesday Session 3, Learning Target] Today I will use a bar model to find how many are in a group when I know how many more or fewer it has.
[11/16 | Science, CER tickets, Day 1] Which tool would you use to measure how hot or cold it is outside?
[11/16 | Science, CER tickets, Day 2] A weather scientist wants to know how much rain fell. Which tool should they use?
[11/16 | Science, CER tickets, Day 3] You want to know which way the wind is blowing. What tool would you use?
[11/16 | Science, CER tickets, Day 4] What weather tool tells us how fast the wind is blowing?
[11/16 | Science, Vocabulary & Strategy] Thermometer, wind vane, rain gauge
